newsitem.title: USA: Fed to extend Fedwire hours starting Dec. 8, 1997.
newsitem.headline: Fed to extend Fedwire hours starting Dec. 8, 1997.

text.p: The Federal Reserve Board said Wednesday it will expand the Fedwire on-line funds transfer service operating hours starting Dec 8, 1997.
The Fedwire on-line funds transfer service will open at 0030 Eastern Time and close at 1830 ET, Monday through Friday, the Fed said. Current operating hours are 0830 ET to 1830 ET.
The Fed in February 1994 had approved expanding the hours of operation to 18 hours a day from 10, and had said an implementation date was to be announced about a year before the effective date.
